findings.reason: path resolution is the recurring duplicate this item exists for, and a second copy of the root/map-name/{ids}.nc rule drifts silently from the owner if the layout ever changes; §1b already retires the same script's element-shape dispatch onto artifact_geometry, so applying the same remedy here (add a map-directory accessor to MachineMapCatalog or the netcdf engine and call it) closes the pattern the plan is otherwise correcting.
findings.text: §1's reader resolves phase_dir = catalog.description_store_root_path() / machine_map.name and then reads phase_dir / f"{ids}.nc", re-implementing the static-over-map addressing that NetCDFTransformEngine.open performs at transform_engine.py:363-369 (Path(root) / machine_map.name, one {ids}.nc per IDS); the plan even names the owner ("the static-over-map addressing transform_engine applies") and then forks the rule instead of extending the owner with a public phase-directory accessor

duplicate_owner-1.reason: plan v18 §1 and §1b resolve each phase directory through NetCDFTransformEngine.open (its returned store's path) with the catalogue's root, layout and map, retiring the reader's own join without adding a public name or editing the engine

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — imas_ambix/plot_style.py hides the sheet, the role table and the direct-label helper behind apply_data_ink / palette / direct_label plus two role constants, and scripts/figures_jt60sa_geometry.py hides catalogue reading and cross-section drawing behind read_phase / cross_section; §2 reuses that one reader rather than reading the store a second time.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the reader re-derives the static-over-map phase directory (root / map.name, then {ids}.nc) that imas_ambix/data/transform_engine.py NetCDFTransformEngine.open owns.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §1 states the new plot_style module "is the first and retires nothing" because imas_ambix/ holds no plotting style code, and the one CLI option (--palette-candidates) "retires and merges nothing" because no existing script draws JT-60SA; §1b explicitly adds no option, module or public name, widening the table behind the existing option.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §1 carries an explicit reuse search over imas_ambix/data/, imas_ambix/gs/ and scripts/, and every mechanism it cites exists and is the right owner: imas_ambix/data/paths.py (JT60SA_ROOT, JT60SA_DESCRIPTION_DIR), imas_ambix/data/eddb.py (channel_path, channel_time_path, UNIT_ATTR), imas_ambix/data/machine_map.py (load_packaged_machine_map, description_store_root_path), and imas_ambix/gs/artifact_geometry.py's struct-level readers; VirtualZarrView is declined with a verification-consistent reason (it needs a CompiledSignalMap — virtual_zarr.py:92).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the style module is justified (imas_ambix/ holds no plotting style code, and the workstation mandate is one style module per repo) and the figure scripts add a capability nothing in scripts/ has (no script draws JT-60SA); the plan states why artifact_geometry.MachineArtifactGeometryReader is not the entry point (it resolves a content-addressed nova artifact by manifest and digest, not a per-phase description store) rather than wrapping it.
